body: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okukhulu ngakunye kunikeza ulwazi mayelana nendlela amaphutha aqhekeka ngayo indlela umhlaba onyakazayo kanye nendlela imiphakathi esabela ngayo, ososayensi bafunda izindawo zokuzamazama komhlaba ukujula ubukhulu amagagasi okuzamazama komhlaba ukuqhuma kobuso kanye nokulandelana kokushaqeka, onjiniyela bahlola indlela izakhiwo ezihlanganisa ngayo imigwaqo nezinhlelo zezinsizakusebenza ngesikhathi sokuzamazama, ukubonwa kokudilika komhlaba imililo yoketshezi ama-tsunami nezinye izingozi kwembula ukuthi imiphumela yokuzamazama komhlaba ingasakazeka kanjani ngale kwephutha lokuqala, izinhlangano eziphuthumayo zifunda izinselelo zokuthutha nokuphendula kwezokuxhumana, izifundo ezivela ekuzamazameni komhlaba okwedlule zinegalelo ekuthuthukisweni kwamamephu ezingozi imikhuba yokwakha izinhlelo zokuqapha ukuhlela okuphuthumayo kanye nemfundo yomphakathi

title: Indlela Ukuzamazama Komhlaba Okushintshe Ngayo Ukuphepha Kwesakhiwo
subtitle: Indlela umonakalo wokuzamazama komhlaba oye wathonya ngayo ubunjiniyela kanye nokwakhiwa
summary: Umonakalo obonwe ngesikhathi sokuzamazama komhlaba komlando usize onjiniyela ukuthi babone ubuthakathaka besakhiwo futhi bathuthukise imikhuba yokuklama ukuzamazama komhlaba
body: Ukuzamazama komhlaba komlando kuye kwabonisa ngokuphindaphindiwe ukuthi ukuxhumeka kwezinto zokwakha izisekelo kanye nekhwalithi yokwakha kuthonya kakhulu ukusebenza kokuzamazama komhlaba, izakhiwo ezonakele zinikeza onjiniyela ubufakazi bokuthi izinhlelo ezahlukene zisabela kanjani ekunyakazeni komhlaba okunamandla, ukwehluleka kungaveza ubuthakathaka obungaqondwanga ngokugcwele ngaphambi kokuzamazama komhlaba, ucwaningo lobunjiniyela kanye nokubonwa okuvela ezenzakalweni zakamuva kungaholela ezindleleni zokuklama ezithuthukisiwe izidingo zokwakha kanye namasu okulungisa kabusha, izakhiwo ezindala ezisengozini zingahlala ziwumthombo obalulekile wengozi ngisho nalapho amazinga okwakha esimanje enamandla khona, ukufunda kokubili izakhiwo ezonakele nezisebenza ngempumelelo kusiza onjiniyela baqonde ukuthi yiziphi izici zokuklama ezithuthukisa ukuphepha

title: Ukufunda Ezinhlekeleleni Zokuzamazama Komhlaba
subtitle: Kungani imiphumela yokuzamazama komhlaba incike kokungaphezu kobukhulu
summary: Izinhlekelele zomlando zibonisa ukuthi imiphumela yokuzamazama komhlaba incike ekulungiseleleni ukuchayeka engozini kanye nezingozi zesibili kanye nosayizi wokuzamazama komhlaba.
body: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okunobukhulu obufanayo kungaveza imiphumela ehluke kakhulu, izehlakalo zomlando zibonisa ukuthi ibanga ukusuka ezindaweni ezinabantu abaningi ukujula kokuzamazama komhlaba i-geology yendawo ubuthakathaka isakhiwo ukuvezwa kwabantu kanye nokulungiselela izimo eziphuthumayo konke kuthinta imiphumela, izingozi zesibili okuhlanganisa ama-tsunami ukudilika komhlaba ukucwila kwamanzi kanye nemililo kungandisa kakhulu ukulahlekelwa, umonakalo emigwaqweni izinhlelo zokuxhumana izibhedlela amanethiwekhi amanzi kanye nezinye ingqalasizinda kungenza kube nzima ukuphendula eziphuthumayo, lezi zifundo zibonisa ukuthi kungani ubukhulu bodwa bungenakuchaza ingozi yokuzamazama komhlaba, ukunciphisa ukulahlekelwa kwesikhathi esizayo kudinga ukuqapha kwesayensi ukulungiswa kokwakha okuqinile imfundo kanye nokuhlela okucabangela izingozi ezahlukene ezikhona esifundeni ngasinye
keyFacts: Ubukhulu bodwa abunqumi imiphumela yokuzamazama komhlaba, ukuchayeka emiphumeleni yenhlekelele, izakhiwo ezisengozini zandisa ingozi, izingozi zesibili zingandisa ukulahlekelwa, ingqalasizinda eyonakele ingavimbela impendulo ephuthumayo, ukulungela kanye nokwakhiwa okuqinile kunganciphisa ingozi
